Can't really recommend the game at the moment, was hoping season 1 would make more improvement and make game much more enjoyable. The improvements are there, but there's still much to desire.

1) Farming: It is a looter shooter so I believe many players that are used to this kind of genre is more or less used to the grind. I think to some extent, if you are not a fan of grind, you might not be the target audience of this genre.

That being said, there is so much to be desired especially for outpost related amorphous.

The amorphous mat drop rate is 25%, but then you have to go to fusion reactor and roll for chance to get a item that you need. The said fusion reactor needs separate mat so if you ran out of it, you will have figure out what void frag you need, which is dependent on character type. The entire play loop of this is just mind numbingly boring, and each steps just to be able to have opportunity to roll for your drop is a huge deterrent.

The biggest culprit of this is Secret Garden, and to some extent Enduring Legacy. Secret Garden nano tube requires you to farm out fusion reactor for 10% chance (on top of 25% chance to acquire the amorphous mat), so realistically you are trying to farm out for 2.5% chance 5 times. I have less of issue with the whole rate while I hope it would get better, but more on the game play loop. The whole cycle doesn't connect well, and could really be better.


2) Monetization: It's Korean game, of course there's issue with monetization in some way. The dye color is so inconsistent between the menu and in game that they had to implement "preview in game" option, and dye is single use which can only be acquired by cash if you want to get a specific dye. 

Many of their products are taken hostage to different bundles. For instance, many people like the spawn from bunny, but its locked behind the ultimate bundle which is like 50~70 USD if you already own the ultimate character?
I wouldn't have much issue with bundle if bundle was appealing, but all it really has is 1 set of skin, a "backpack" skin, and 2 donuts (catalyst which is used to improve your gun or character). The whole package is very much not worth the price.

You can really p2w on the stoarge spaces (and if you are not sure how good of that is, think of it like PoE stashes), and there's no way for you to get additional preset slot (which is used to have several preset of your different characters) other than just buying it with cash.


3) Content: It is very clear that the dev and nexon as whole didn't think this game would get any form of traction. They are ill-prepared, new content feels very rushed, and not properly tested. Hailey practically time gated unless you really want to mindlessly grind specific infiltration missions specifically on new content, and new content is so boring and un-intuitive, some of the mechanic just doesn't feel like it belongs in looter shooter genre. Only saving grace for the new content is that it gives butt load of gold, which at least let me stop doing valby run.


On the bright side, the characters are basically what many horny gamers are looking for, lots of assets. Too bad their new skin doesn't seem to reflect that they don't understand about the said assets and they don't even look cool, it just look like they pulled it out from a 2000s mmo.


I wouldn't recommend this game to any one at current state, the developers have been more or less trying to be more attentive, but they are just slow probably due to the lack of people that are working on this game.

How I got help in this case? You MUST go to global nexon support site, live chat support team, and create ticket to TFD team from this chat, in this case, you will get e-mail answeres instead of tickets on TFD support site, I don't know how priorities works on Nexon system, but only this department actually helped me to get my account back

The Grind is too demanding, the game play loses it's interest way too fast to keep the incredibly demanding grind interesting. The story is very cheesy and feels like Nexon put very little effort into making it compelling. 
I had to grind for a material 52 times to grind an intercept mission 52 times to get a descendant code.. 
i still don't have that descendant code.. 
Nexon needs to ask themselves, which is better? To have a happy player grinding their 100% investment? or a pissed off player grinding their half effort waste of time? 
I suggest Nexon copy another game yet further... like they tried to do here already, cough warframe cough,
and make a market place where descendant codes can be purchased with gold and parts to that code ie enhanced cells etc, a slight bit more attainable and force the grind for resources. 

This game has some seriously embarrassing predatory microtransactions... 25 caliber.. for ONE color? and that color is exclusive to the skin purchased for? REALLY? 

a single reactor is the equivalent of $20 U.S. Dollars... 

 Unless some very very serious changes are made, this game is dead where it stands.. 

My recommendation is to find a looter shooter that isn't a waste of your time and insult to your gaming intelligence.
